## Context / Problem
Five items in the plan-review attestation stack were independently confirmed dead or duplicated on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1 (operator ruling: the residue is approved only because it was confirmed dead by both semantic references and string grep). `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py:270-307 _hash_basis(at_current_gate_ref=...)`: every src caller passes no kwarg (`code_review/region_gate.py:62`, `code_review/sidecar.py:258`, `plan_review/attest.py:244`, `manifest.py:440`, `workflow/plan_review_recovery.py:252,255`); the branch `:302-303` delegates to `gate_ref_hash_basis` at `:240-267`, and only `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ref_coherence.py:185,190,195,238` pass it. `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/read_set.py:189-214 terraform_membership_entries` (plus `_TERRAFORM_GLOB_SUFFIXES:186`) has no src caller; only `tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py:223-231` (ADR 0115 `:86-87` defers remote module content only, not membership globs; under ADR 0111 code waiting for a consumer is deleted). `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pin_health.py:15-18 PlanValidityProfile{DEFAULT,CLOSE,DRIFT_REFRESH}` is read once, `attest.py:683 if profile is PlanValidityProfile.DEFAULT`, so CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH are identical and nothing serialises `.value` or `.name`. `attest.py:439-446` and `:478-486` render a byte-identical "cannot confirm the code the plan was reviewed against is current" message. `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json:11` lists `not-closed`, produced only under `kind == "completion-verifier"` (`attest.py:641-646`); `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest_gate.py:149` passes `signing.verify_signature`'s verdict through (`mismatch`, `foreign_key`, `key_not_valid_at_era`, `invalid`, `unavailable`, `unknown_kind`, `unknown_scheme`; `src/rebar/types.py:361-371`), all outside the enum; `tests/unit/test_opcert_cross_environment_c21f.py:225` observes the leak. `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py:494-503` declares `verdict: str` with no enum mirror, `types.py` has no `PlanReviewStatus`, so no other surface changes.

## Approach
1. `manifest.py`: delete `:302-303` and docstring bullets `:281-294`; signature becomes `def _hash_basis(repo_root=None) -> str`.
2. `read_set.py`: delete `:186` and `:189-214`.
3. `pin_health.py`: delete `DRIFT_REFRESH`; `attest.py:262` becomes `profile=PlanValidityProfile.CLOSE` with comment "CLOSE = skip code-freshness (the only non-DEFAULT behaviour)"; edit the `:502` and `:552` comments. `src/rebar/_commands/gates.py:269`, `attest_gate.py:162`, `src/rebar/llm/code_review/bugfix_size_gate.py:260`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md:1099` unchanged.
4. `attest.py`: add `def _unresolvable_ref_reason(ref: str | None) -> str` returning the shared string (`named = f"'{ref}'" if ref else "the configured gate ref"`); `:441-446` becomes `return _unresolvable_ref_reason(basis.ref)`; `:482-486` becomes `return _unresolvable_ref_reason(ref)`.
5. `attest_gate.py:149` becomes `"verdict": "unsigned",` (the verify-layer verdict is already in `reason` via `:143 signature: {result.get('verdict')}`). Drop `not-closed` from `plan_review_status.schema.json:11` and from prose at `attest_gate.py:193` and `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py:183` (`docs/mcp-reference.md` carries only first paragraphs, no regeneration; `src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:310` is the completion-verifier surface where `not-closed` IS reachable, leave it).
6. `docs/release-notes.md`: "`plan_review_status.verdict` enum narrowed: `not-closed` (never emitted on this surface) removed; an unverifiable signature now reports `unsigned` with the signing verdict in `reason` instead of leaking `mismatch` or `foreign_key`. Backward-compatible for readers under `docs/api-stability.md:23` (no required key removed or retyped; the emitted set shrinks to the declared enum)."

## Scope
The files above. Out of scope: `_legacy_material_ok` (`attest.py:745`, callers `:71,652,705`, corpus contract `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:10,39`), the delta explainers, `compute_validity`'s completion arm.

## Testing
`test_ref_coherence.py:185,190,195,238`: `attest._hash_basis(str(repo), at_current_gate_ref=True)` becomes `manifest.gate_ref_hash_basis(str(repo)).path`; assertions unchanged. Delete `test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py:223-231`. `.DRIFT_REFRESH` becomes `.CLOSE` at `tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py:296`, `tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_validity.py:35`, `tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py:106`, `tests/unit/test_drift_refresh_candidate.py:56`. Add `tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_drift.py::test_unresolvable_ref_reason_is_single_sourced` (scoped and unscoped paths yield `_unresolvable_ref_reason(ref)` verbatim). Add to `tests/unit/test_mcp_plan_review_status.py` a parametrized test over the seven leaked `verify_signature` stub verdicts asserting `verdict == "unsigned"`, the original verdict `in reason`, and that the result validates against `plan_review_status.schema.json` with jsonschema. `test_opcert_cross_environment_c21f.py:225` unchanged. `tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py:28` and `tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py:418` unchanged (completion arm).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -n "at_current_gate_ref\|terraform_membership_entries\|DRIFT_REFRESH\|_TERRAFORM_GLOB_SUFFIXES" -- src tests docs` prints nothing.
- [ ] `git grep -c "could not be resolved to a snapshot" -- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py` prints `1`.
- [ ] `python -c "import json;print('not-closed' in json.load(open('src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json'))['properties']['verdict']['enum'])"` prints `False`.
- [ ] The new parametrized status test is green; `tests/unit/test_bugfix_size_gate_ad0d.py:71` is still green.
- [ ] `python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types --check` is clean; `make verify` exits 0.
